profile.summary: Principal level software engineer with professional experience providing software engineering and DevOps expertise. Experienced in creating, maintaining, integrating and testing software in Windows and Unix environments. Distinguished performance driving innovation with expertise in various  programming languages including  Java and C++.

positions.title: Owner & Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as a developer enhancing a system that provides virtual application environments for customers. Upgrading microservices through multiple iterations of Java with the sole purpose of handling technical debt and allow access to new features, security updates and performance enhancements. 

Served as a developer responsible for developing a system that is responsible for analyzing and presenting virtual machine resource data. Developed CloudFormation stacks which leverage lambda functions in Python that are used for administrative tasks like EC2 instance management and REST endpoints in API Gateway within an AWS environment. Developed code in YAML for the CloudFormation templates that defined the stacks. For the resources working under the hood of the stacks, developed data endpoints for our user interface. Responsible for DDL scripts and lambda layers which are used for data ingest. Developed and maintained the Bamboo CI/CD environment for continuous integration for the frontend and backend codebases. Leveraged Docker to create a SonarQube system for software code analysis.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Java · Docker · Software Engineering · REST · Python · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Digital & Cyber Solutions Lead
positions.description:
Served as a full stack developer responsible for modernizing a J2EE application and converting it to a containerized SpringBoot system. Developed software that consists of a backend that consists of a backend that has REST services using JPA and a frontend that uses Angular. Leveraged Docker and Docker Compose to create system images that are deployed to multiple integration and production environments. Developed GitLab YAML scripts to assist in continuous integration. Added annotations to the backend software so that they can activate the SwaggerUI for REST service testing.

Served as lead developer and integrator on a project that has a focus of advancing and modernizing capability and component registry systems. Developed custom software using a stack consisting of ElasticSearch, Docker, MySQL and Grails to create a suite of solutions specific to customer needs. One of those solutions involved creating an algorithm to map location data to information stored in a COTS system for data enrichment. Developed Selenium scripts to help with the automated health monitoring capability for the system. Served as a technical trainer to assist with a product transition effort. Served as the lead on an effort to modernize and consolidating multiple applications to create one system for customers.

Served as the Digital & Cyber Solutions lead for PLEX helping provide software solutions for the rapid prototyping division within the company. Supported management activities on four different programs including recruiting, market surveys, and employee welfare.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Java · Docker · Software Engineering · REST · Spring Boot · Elasticsearch

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as a cloud developer on a project that specializes in mission analytics. Created custom data visualizations using ExtJS and RESTful web services that leveraged Impala for query processing. Rewrote the Impala data ingest process from Bash scripts to Python to ensure robustness, resiliency and maintainability. Managed data flows across testing and production environments using Nifi. Used Ansible to create playbooks that help perform administrative duties across a 100 plus machine cluster environment.
  
Worked as a researcher assisting in expanding business by developing internal research efforts that provide opportunities for incoming staff and help grow business development efforts.  Served as a member of Amches' technical exchange council and helped establish and enhance the company's strategic technical activities.

Served as a J2EE developer for a system specializing in visualization and geolocation analysis of network data. Created modular components for the system’s graphical user interface using a pure Java framework including technologies like JavaFX, GraphStream, NASA Worldwind and the H2 database. Developed a similar web based architecture consisting of Spring based data parsers that use Camel for routing files pulled from Hadoop HDFS and creating the components that leverages GWT and the OpenMap API. Maintained a continuous integration distribution system that automatically builds, tests, packages and deploys multiple systems an integration suite.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Java · Software Engineering · Python · Ansible · Jenkins · Apache Impala

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a developer on a dashboard data visualization effort providing ingestion services using JMS, REST and Spring integration to contain it in Mongo and Redis data stores. Developed a Docker based solution to containerize the ingestion services. Performed frontend development with Ember on top of a SailsJS MVC framework.Performed requirements analysis and participates in creating system design documentation for new capabilities. Created prototypes and proof of concept capabilities to promote new technology to enhance the dashboard. Helped provide build management support using Maven, Nexus and Jenkins.

Served as a Java PKI developer on an agile development program providing development support for Type 1 PKI key establishment to include multiple Certificate Authority services and Trust Anchors for the users of the system. Performed development activities using a combination of Spring, MongoDB, and Oracle technologies along with additional custom Information Assurance tools. 

Served as a cloud developer on a program that specializes in trending analytics. Implemented analytics using Hadoop MapReduce and performed testing against them using MRUnit. Created custom data visualization web applications using ExtJS and RESTful web services. 

Served as a J2EE developer on a mission visualization system that was deployed on a widget framework. Coordinated the development, integration and documentation on a variety of efforts including creating metrics reporting, system monitoring, temporal, and geolocation visualizations in ExtJs. Developed a continuous integration distribution system that automatically builds, tests, packages and deploys the entire system to an integration suite. Served as the operational coordinator that handled any customer needs related to the system.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Java · Software Engineering · Hadoop · Spring Framework · Node.js · MongoDB

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as a developer and integrator on a signature repository project where I coordinated the development, integration and documentation efforts. 

Provided software engineering support for a network analysis system using the SWT and the Eclipse Rich Client Platform plug-in architecture. 

Developed web portlets for an Operational Performance Assessment portal within a J2EE environment. 

Developed and maintained software on an object oriented C++ framework which included tools that used OCR recognition software and tools which performed various types of signal and image processing.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Java · Software Engineering · C++ · Drupal · LAMP

Protect Us Kids Foundation (www.protect-us-kids.org) is a 501c3 non-profit that focuses on providing resources and tools for youth within rural, underserved and marginalized populations globally; to include developing critical targeted research of Online Child Sexual Exploitation (OCSE) against youth within this demographic globally. Our mission is to protect youth from being victimized by predators who leverage cyberspace as an international exploitation tactic. 

Leveraging deep expertise within cybersecurity, research, intelligence, and analysis (to include strategic partnerships in support of the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)/ Machine Learning (ML), and data science/data analytics), Protect us Kids Foundation strives to make a global impact through advocacy, research, and practical approaches towards contributing to meaningful solutions that will dramatically reverse the rising rate of OCSE of youth that reside within rural, underserved and marginalized communities.
 
In support of our mission, Protect Us Kids Foundation has the following key contributing goals:
 
-Promote cybersecurity awareness within the communities that we serve, to ensure that access to viable mental health, technology and cybersecurity resources are readily available at all times.
 
-Formally engage with humanitarian organizations, corporations, and international governments, to work collectively towards addressing the continued liability and legal challenges in human trafficking prevention in cyberspace and the effects of globalization and forced servitude.
 
-Support the establishment of innovative, yet ethically sound, data governance measures that serve to protect and maintain the privacy of exploited youth online.

Protect Us Kids Foundation (www.protect-us-kids.org) is a 501c3 non-profit that focuses on providing resources and tools for youth within rural, underserved and marginalized populations globally; to include developing critical targeted research of Online Child Sexual Exploitation (OCSE) against youth within this demographic globally. Our mission is to protect youth from being victimized by predators who leverage cyberspace as an international exploitation tactic. 

Leveraging deep expertise within cybersecurity, research, intelligence, and analysis (to include strategic partnerships in support of the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)/ Machine Learning (ML), and data science/data analytics), Protect us Kids Foundation strives to make a global impact through advocacy, research, and practical approaches towards contributing to meaningful solutions that will dramatically reverse the rising rate of OCSE of youth that reside within rural, underserved and marginalized communities.
 
In support of our mission, Protect Us Kids Foundation has the following key contributing goals:
 
-Promote cybersecurity awareness within the communities that we serve, to ensure that access to viable mental health, technology and cybersecurity resources are readily available at all times.
 
-Formally engage with humanitarian organizations, corporations, and international governments, to work collectively towards addressing the continued liability and legal challenges in human trafficking prevention in cyberspace and the effects of globalization and forced servitude.
 
-Support the establishment of innovative, yet ethically sound, data governance measures that serve to protect and maintain the privacy of exploited youth online.
